{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''[[Listening post/Legends|listening post]]''' was established by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corjain]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Built without the knowledge of the New Republic, it served to keep tabs on the mission of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', and on the provisional government installed on the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] following the successful ousting of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. The outpost also served as a base for a small patrol formation.
